name: Asamori Mitsuki
source:
Favorite series: None in particular.
Favorite character: [url=/c78244]Mimi[/url].

Mitsuki is a first year high school student. Very kind and attractive, she is one of the most popular students in the school despite the fact that she is only in the first grade. However, her popularity is not only related to her kindness and beauty, but she is also a very popular seiyuu, and is especially known for her role as the character Mimi. Through her work, many people do not see and want to become friends with the "Seiyuu Mitsuki" but no one really wants to know the "real Mitsuki", the young girl she is every day. Because of this, Mitsuki often disguises herself in order not to be recognized in the streets.

[url=/c75586]Kyouya[/url] is the first person she met who wanted to know the "real Mitsuki" and since then she has a very obvious crush on him.
